advisor_identified: Historian of early modern France and professor of history at the University of Manitoba.

evidence.says: Identifies Henry Heller as professor of history at the University of Manitoba and author of four books on early modern France.
Lists his education as Cornell University, Ph.D., 1969, and his University of Manitoba history appointments beginning in 1963.

Heather M. Vose, A Sixteenth-century Assessment of the French Church in the Years 1521-4 by Bishop Guillaume Briconnet of Meaux, footnote 56, cites Henry Heller, Reform and reformers at Meaux, 1518-1525, unpublished PhD dissertation, Cornell University, 1969.

notes: The advisor biography and independent scholarly dissertation citation agree on Cornell and 1969; the citation also matches the linked record author and title. No separate library catalogue record was retrieved.
